Name: DisableExceptionChainValidation
Description: Structured Exception Handling Overwrite Protection (SEHOP) must be enabled.

Name: NoLockScreenSlideshow
Description: The display of slide shows on the lock screen must be disabled.

Name: DisableIpSourceRouting
Description: IPv6 source routing must be configured to highest protection.

Name: DisableIPSourceRouting
Description: The system must be configured to prevent IP source routing.

Name: EnableICMPRedirect
Description: The system must be configured to prevent Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP) redirects from overriding Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) generated routes.

Name: NoNameReleaseOnDemand
Description: The system must be configured to ignore NetBIOS name release requests except from WINS servers.

Name: UseLogonCredential
Description: WDigest Authentication must be disabled.

Name: AllowInsecureGuestAuth
Description: Insecure logons to an SMB server must be disabled.

Name: NC_ShowSharedAccessUI
Description: Internet connection sharing must be disabled.

Name: fMinimizeConnections
Description: Simultaneous connections to the internet or a Windows domain must be limited.

Name: fBlockNonDomain
Description: Connections to non-domain networks when connected to a domain authenticated network must be blocked.

Name: ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine_Enabled
Description: Command line data must be included in process creation events.

Name: AllowProtectedCreds
Description: Windows 11 must be configured to enable Remote host allows delegation of non-exportable credentials.

Name: LsaCfgFlags
Description: Credential Guard must be running on Windows 11 systems.

Name: NoGPOListChanges
Description: Group Policy objects must be reprocessed even if they have not changed.

Name: DisableWebPnPDownload
Description: Downloading print driver packages over HTTP must be prevented.

Name: NoWebServices
Description: Web publishing and online ordering wizards must be prevented from downloading a list of providers.

Name: DisableHTTPPrinting
Description: Printing over HTTP must be prevented.

Name: DontDisplayNetworkSelectionUI
Description: The network selection user interface (UI) must not be displayed on the logon screen.

Name: DCSettingIndex
Description: Users must be prompted for a password on resume from sleep (on battery).

Name: ACSettingIndex
Description: The user must be prompted for a password on resume from sleep (plugged in).

Name: fAllowToGetHelp
Description: Solicited Remote Assistance must not be allowed.

Name: RestrictRemoteClients
Description: Unauthenticated RPC clients must be restricted from connecting to the RPC server.

Name: MSAOptional
Description: The setting to allow Microsoft accounts to be optional for modern style apps must be enabled.

Name: DisableInventory
Description: The Application Compatibility Program Inventory must be prevented from collecting data and sending the information to Microsoft.

Name: NoAutoplayfornonVolume
Description: Autoplay must be turned off for non-volume devices.

Name: NoAutorun
Description: The default autorun behavior must be configured to prevent autorun commands.

Name: NoDriveTypeAutoRun
Description: Autoplay must be disabled for all drives.

Name: FacialFeaturesUseEnhancedAntiSpoofing  (For Intune-managed systems)
Description: Enhanced anti-spoofing for facial recognition must be enabled on Windows 11.

Name: EnumerateAdministrators
Description: Administrator accounts must not be enumerated during elevation.

Name: AllowTelemetry
Description: Windows Telemetry must not be configured to Full.

Name: DODownloadMode
Description: Windows Update must not obtain updates from other PCs on the internet.

Name: NoDataExecutionPrevention
Description: Explorer Data Execution Prevention must be enabled.

Name: NoHeapTerminationOnCorruption
Description: File Explorer heap termination on corruption must be disabled.

Name: PreXPSP2ShellProtocolBehavior
Description: File Explorer shell protocol must run in protected mode.

Name: DisablePasswordSaving
Description: Passwords must not be saved in the Remote Desktop Client.

Name: fDisableCdm
Description: Local drives must be prevented from sharing with Remote Desktop Session Hosts.

Name: fPromptForPassword
Description: Remote Desktop Services must always prompt a client for passwords upon connection.

Name: fEncryptRPCTraffic
Description: The Remote Desktop Session Host must require secure RPC communications.

Name: MinEncryptionLevel
Description: Remote Desktop Services must be configured with the client connection encryption set to the required level.

Name: DisableEnclosureDownload
Description: Attachments must be prevented from being downloaded from RSS feeds.

Name: AllowBasicAuthInClear
Description: Basic authentication for RSS feeds over HTTP must not be used.

Name: AllowIndexingEncryptedStoresOrItems
Description: Indexing of encrypted files must be turned off.

Name: EnableUserControl
Description: Users must be prevented from changing installation options.

Name: AlwaysInstallElevated
Description: The Windows Installer feature "Always install with elevated privileges" must be disabled.

Name: SafeForScripting
Description: Users must be notified if a web-based program attempts to install software.

Name: DisableAutomaticRestartSignOn
Description: Automatically signing in the last interactive user after a system-initiated restart must be disabled.

Name: EnableScriptBlockLogging
Description: PowerShell script block logging must be enabled on Windows 11.

Name: AllowBasic
Description: The Windows Remote Management (WinRM) client must not use Basic authentication.

Name: AllowUnencryptedTraffic
Description: The Windows Remote Management (WinRM) client must not allow unencrypted traffic.

Name: AllowBasic
Description: The Windows Remote Management (WinRM) service must not use Basic authentication.

Name: AllowUnencryptedTraffic
Description: The Windows Remote Management (WinRM) service must not allow unencrypted traffic.

Name: DisableRunAs
Description: The Windows Remote Management (WinRM) service must not store RunAs credentials.

Name: AllowDigest
Description: The Windows Remote Management (WinRM) client must not use Digest authentication.

Name: LetAppsActivateWithVoiceAboveLock
Description: Windows 11 must be configured to prevent Windows apps from being activated by voice while the system is locked.

Name: DeviceEnumerationPolicy
Description: Windows 11 Kernel (Direct Memory Access) DMA Protection must be enabled.

Name: LimitBlankPasswordUse
Description: Local accounts with blank passwords must be restricted to prevent access from the network.

Name: SCENoApplyLegacyAuditPolicy
Description: Audit policy using subcategories must be enabled.

Name: RequireSignOrSeal
Description: Outgoing secure channel traffic must be encrypted or signed.

Name: SealSecureChannel
Description: Outgoing secure channel traffic must be encrypted.

Name: SignSecureChannel
Description: Outgoing secure channel traffic must be signed.

Name: DisablePasswordChange
Description: The computer account password must not be prevented from being reset.

Name: RequireStrongKey
Description: The system must be configured to require a strong session key.

Name: RequireSecuritySignature
Description: The Windows SMB client must be configured to always perform SMB packet signing.

Name: EnablePlainTextPassword
Description: Unencrypted passwords must not be sent to third-party SMB Servers.

Name: RequireSecuritySignature
Description: The Windows SMB server must be configured to always perform SMB packet signing.

Name: RestrictAnonymousSAM
Description: Anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts must not be allowed.

Name: RestrictAnonymous
Description: Anonymous enumeration of shares must be restricted.

Name: EveryoneIncludesAnonymous
Description: The system must be configured to prevent anonymous users from having the same rights as the Everyone group.

Name: RestrictNullSessAccess
Description: Anonymous access to Named Pipes and Shares must be restricted.

Name: allownullsessionfallback
Description: NTLM must be prevented from falling back to a Null session.

Name: AllowOnlineID
Description: PKU2U authentication using online identities must be prevented.

Name: SupportedEncryptionTypes
Description: Kerberos encryption types must be configured to prevent the use of DES and RC4 encryption suites.

Name: NoLMHash
Description: The system must be configured to prevent the storage of the LAN Manager hash of passwords.

Name: LmCompatibilityLevel
Description: The LanMan authentication level must be set to send NTLMv2 response only, and to refuse LM and NTLM.

Name: LDAPClientIntegrity
Description: The system must be configured to the required LDAP client signing level.

Name: NTLMMinClientSec
Description: The system must be configured to meet the minimum session security requirement for NTLM SSP based clients.

Name: NTLMMinServerSec
Description: The system must be configured to meet the minimum session security requirement for NTLM SSP based servers.

Name: Enabled
Description: The system must be configured to use FIPS-compliant algorithms for encryption, hashing, and signing.

Name: ProtectionMode
Description: The default permissions of global system objects must be increased.

Name: FilterAdministratorToken
Description: User Account Control approval mode for the built-in Administrator must be enabled.

Name: ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin
Description: User Account Control must prompt administrators for consent on the secure desktop.

Name: ConsentPromptBehaviorUser
Description: User Account Control must automatically deny elevation requests for standard users.

Name: EnableInstallerDetection
Description: User Account Control must be configured to detect application installations and prompt for elevation.

Name: EnableSecureUIAPaths
Description: User Account Control must only elevate UIAccess applications that are installed in secure locations.

Name: EnableLUA
Description: User Account Control must run all administrators in Admin Approval Mode, enabling UAC.

Name: EnableVirtualization
Description: User Account Control must virtualize file and registry write failures to per-user locations.

Name: DisableUserAuth
Description: Windows 11 systems must block consumer account user authentication.

Name: LetAppsActivateWithVoice
Description: Windows 11 must be configured to prevent Windows apps from being activated by voice.
